rules: Operates within a single city containing an owned station token, and may optionally include 1 town on its run[cite: 156, 170].
Only one L-train may run on each station token[cite: 156, 170].
May be upgraded to a 2-train during the train purchase step by flipping the card and paying $80[cite: 155, 158].
Unsold minor companies at end of SR export one L-train each from the bank[cite: 149].

Rusted upon Phase 4[cite: 141, 155].

Must include a station with an owned token and at least one other revenue location[cite: 156].
May not visit more than one station in a single city hex[cite: 156].
Rusted and removed from play without compensation upon the first 4-train purchase[cite: 141, 155].

1822_ca_3.notes: First purchase/export advances game to Phase 3: all L-trains rust, green tiles available, majors can lay 2 yellow or 1 upgrade, southern route opens (Duluth to Detroit), and train sales between companies become permitted[cite: 141, 142]. Rusted and removed from play without compensation upon the first 6-train purchase[cite: 141, 155].

1822_ca_4.notes: First purchase advances game to Phase 4: all 2-trains rust, minor company train limit drops to 1, and major company train limit drops to 3[cite: 141, 142]. Pool: 6 trains at $300[cite: 155]. Rusted upon Phase 7[cite: 141, 155].

Must include a station containing an owned token and at least one other revenue location[cite: 156].
Rusted and removed from play without compensation upon the first 7-train or E-train purchase[cite: 141, 155].

1822_ca_5.notes: Permanent locomotive[cite: 155]. First purchase advances game to Phase 5: concessions removed, brown tiles available, major train limit drops to 2, majors float at 50% sold, and unfloated minors can be acquired directly from bid boxes for $200[cite: 141, 142]. Pool: 3 trains at $500[cite: 155] (an additional 5-train can enter via private P1 Montreal Locomotive Works[cite: 155, 172]).
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 155].
Runs up to 5 revenue locations[cite: 156].
Must include an owned station token and at least one other revenue location[cite: 156].

1822_ca_6.notes: Permanent locomotive[cite: 155]. First purchase advances game to Phase 6: all 3-trains rust immediately, and newly floated majors receive full 10-share capitalization with remaining 5 shares placed in bank pool[cite: 141, 142, 147]. Pool: 3 trains at $600[cite: 155].
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 155].
Runs up to 6 revenue locations[cite: 156].
Must include an owned station token and at least one other revenue location[cite: 156].

1822_ca_7.notes: Permanent locomotive[cite: 155]. Printed back-to-back with E-train (16 cards provided, unlimited supply)[cite: 155]. Buyer chooses 7 or E side upon purchase; cannot be flipped or converted later[cite: 155, 159]. First purchase of 7 or E advances game to Phase 7: all 4-trains rust, grey tiles available, and P8/P9 removed from play[cite: 141, 142].
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 155].
Runs up to 7 revenue locations[cite: 156].
Must include an owned station token and at least one other revenue location[cite: 156].

1822_ca_e.name: E
1822_ca_e.summary: Express E-train (unlimited tokened cities, 2x revenue, ignores towns; permanent)
1822_ca_e.notes: Permanent locomotive[cite: 155]. Printed back-to-back with 7-train ($1,000)[cite: 155]. Maximum 1 E-train per company[cite: 155, 159]. Minors can own but cannot run an E-train[cite: 155, 159].
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 155].
Stops ONLY at cities and off-board locations containing a station token of the owning company[cite: 156].
Passes through other intermediate revenue locations without counting their values (towns can never be counted)[cite: 156].
DOUBLES the value of each tokened location visited (quadruples destination cities when running home-to-destination)[cite: 156, 157, 170]!
May reuse track segments used by other trains of the same company in the same operating round[cite: 156, 170].
Cannot use Pullmans or Grain Trains[cite: 156].
Maximum of one E-train per company[cite: 155, 159].

1822_ca_2p.available_on: Phase 2 (via P3 Toronto Locomotive Works or P4 Countess of Dufferin)
1822_ca_2p.summary: Permanent 2P Special Train (runs 2 locations; independent dividend handling)
1822_ca_2p.notes: Permanent special locomotive originating from private companies P3 and P4[cite: 155, 172]. Maximum 1 special train per company[cite: 155, 172]. Does not rust, does not count against train limit, does not satisfy mandatory train ownership, and cannot be sold between companies[cite: 155, 170, 172].
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 155].
Runs up to 2 revenue locations[cite: 156].
Does not count against train limit and does not satisfy mandatory train ownership[cite: 155, 170, 172].
May split, pay in full, or withhold its revenue completely independently of the company's regular trains[cite: 155, 157, 158, 170, 172].
Compatible with Pullmans and Grain Trains[cite: 156].

rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 155].
Operates on a single owned station token, and optionally visits 1 town[cite: 156].
Does not count against train limit and does not satisfy mandatory train ownership[cite: 155, 170, 172].
May distribute its earnings independently of the company's other trains[cite: 155, 157, 158, 170, 172].
Compatible with Grain Trains; cannot be used with Pullmans[cite: 156].

1822_ca_p.name: Pullman
1822_ca_p.available_on: Phase 5 (via P5 Pullman Car Company or P6 Fulton Car Works)
1822_ca_p.summary: Auxiliary Pullman Car (attaches to train; scores up to 2N towns without consuming stops)
1822_ca_p.notes: Auxiliary car originating from private companies P5 and P6[cite: 155, 172]. Attaches to an N-train to allow up to 2N towns to be scored as free stops[cite: 156, 168, 170, 172]. Max 1 Pullman per company; cannot be sold between companies[cite: 155, 168, 170, 172].
rules: Permanent auxiliary car: Does not count against train limit or satisfy train ownership[cite: 155, 170, 172].
Attaches to one normal N-train (or 2P-train); can be reallocated each operating round[cite: 156].
Allows the attached train to visit up to N cities/off-boards and up to 2N towns, scoring all visited towns without counting them against the N-stop allowance[cite: 156, 168, 170, 172].
Never collects revenue from grain elevators or ports[cite: 156].
Cannot be attached to an LP-train, E-train, or Grain Train[cite: 156, 168].

1822_ca_g.name: Grain Train
1822_ca_g.available_on: Phase 3 (via P26 Saskatchewan Wheat Pool or P27 Alberta Wheat Pool)
1822_ca_g.summary: Auxiliary Grain Train (attaches to major company train; hauls elevator freight to ports)
1822_ca_g.notes: Auxiliary freight car originating from private companies P26 and P27[cite: 155, 174]. Major companies only (minors cannot hold)[cite: 155, 156]. Does not count against train limit or satisfy train ownership[cite: 155, 170, 174]. Max 1 per company[cite: 155, 168].
rules: Permanent auxiliary car: Attaches to one train per operating round[cite: 155, 157, 174].
Converts attached train to a grain train[cite: 156, 174].
Collects +$10 for each grain elevator visited along the route (town itself earns $0 revenue and does not count as a stop)[cite: 156, 157, 168, 174].
If the route includes at least one elevator and connects to a port city, awards +$20 per port (max 2 ports: one west coast, one east)[cite: 157, 168, 174].
Cannot be used by minor companies or attached to an E-train or Pullman[cite: 155, 156, 168].

rules: Traverses up to 2 hex edges (origin hex not counted)[cite: 193].
Route must contain two or more cities, towns, or off-board locations, including at least one city with an owned station token[cite: 193].
All cities, towns, and off-board locations on route count for revenue[cite: 193].
May run to, but not through, Paris or token-blocked cities[cite: 193].

rules: Traverses up to 4 hex edges[cite: 193].
Must connect at least two revenue locations, including an owned station token[cite: 193].
Scores all traversed cities, towns, and off-board areas[cite: 193].
Rusted and removed from play without compensation upon the purchase of the first 10H train[cite: 183, 194].

1826_6h.name: 6H

rules: Traverses up to 6 hex edges[cite: 193].
Must include an owned station token[cite: 193].
May be traded between corporations for any agreed price (min F1; Etat and SNCF trade only at face value)[cite: 190, 191, 194, 195].
Rusted and removed from play without compensation upon the purchase of the first E-train[cite: 183, 194].

1826_10h.name: 10H
1826_10h.summary: Steam 10H permanent locomotive (traverses up to 10 hex edges; SNCF merger trigger)

Pool: 2 to 5 trains depending on available corps (F600 each)[cite: 192, 194].
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 183, 194].
Traverses up to 10 hex edges[cite: 193].
Must include an owned station token[cite: 193].
Scaled supply: 5 available if 10 corps in play, reduced by 1 per missing corp down to min 2[cite: 192].

1826_e.name: E

rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts[cite: 183, 194].
Counts CITIES and off-board locations rather than hex edges; completely ignores 10-value towns for revenue and distance[cite: 197].

Connects a variable number of cities based on total E-trains in play: 1 in play = 2D (2 cities, doubled revenue); 2 or 3 in play = 3D; 4 in play = 4D; after first TGV bought = 5 cities (normal single revenue)[cite: 198].
Revenue from all connected cities is DOUBLED until the first TGV is bought; runs for normal revenue thereafter[cite: 198].

1826_tgv.name: TGV

Connects up to 3 cities or off-board locations, ignoring all towns[cite: 198].
ALWAYS runs for DOUBLED revenue regardless of the number in play[cite: 198].
May REUSE track segments already used by the corporation's other trains in the same operating round[cite: 193, 198]!
Purchasing the first TGV causes all E-trains to revert to normal (single) revenue[cite: 198].
Maximum of one TGV per corporation[cite: 198].

18_scan_2.summary: Regular 2-train (max 2 cities, or 1 city and 1 town)
18_scan_2.notes: Phase 2 regular locomotive. Paired in train stack with 1+1 (total pool: 6 trains across both models). Train limit: Minor 2, Corporation 4. Incremental funding (2 shares to float). First off-map values used. Rusted upon purchase of first 4/3+3 train.
rules: Scores up to 2 cities, or 1 city and 1 town along a legal continuous route.
Must include a city containing a station token of the operating company.
May visit an Off-Map Area only if containing an owned station token (must be at route terminus).
Eligible for +K20 Turku-Stockholm Ferry bonus if company owns Ferry token.
Rusted and removed from the game without compensation upon purchase of the first 4/3+3 train.

18_scan_1p1.notes: Phase 2 plus locomotive. Costs K20 less than regular 2-train. Paired in stack with 2-train (total pool: 6). Rusted upon purchase of first 4/3+3 train.
rules: Scores up to 1 city and up to 1 town along a continuous route.
Must include a city containing an owned station token.
Costs K80 (K20 discount relative to regular 2-train).
Rusted and removed from the game without compensation upon purchase of the first 4/3+3 train.

18_scan_3.summary: Regular 3-train (max 3 cities, or up to 2 towns with 1 city)
18_scan_3.notes: Purchasing first 3/2+2 advances game to Phase 3: green tiles become available, second off-map values used, and corporations require 3 shares to float (incremental funding). Paired in stack with 2+2 (total pool: 4). Train limit: Minor 2, Corporation 4. Rusted upon first 5/4+4 train.
rules: Scores up to 3 cities, or up to 2 towns (assuming 1 city) along a continuous route.
Must include a city with an owned station token.
Eligible for Ferry bonus (+K20) and Kiruna Mine bonus (+K50) if applicable tokens owned.
Rusted and removed from the game without compensation upon purchase of the first 5/4+4 train.

18_scan_2p2.summary: Plus 2+2 train (max 2 cities and up to 3 towns)
18_scan_2p2.notes: Phase 3 plus locomotive. Costs K20 less than regular 3-train. Paired in stack with 3-train (total pool: 4). Rusted upon purchase of first 5/4+4 train.
rules: Scores up to 2 cities and up to 3 towns (assuming 1 city) along a continuous route.
Must include an owned station token.
Costs K180 (K20 discount relative to regular 3-train).
Rusted and removed from the game without compensation upon purchase of the first 5/4+4 train.

18_scan_4.summary: Regular 4-train (max 4 cities, or up to 3 towns with 1 city)
18_scan_4.notes: Purchasing first 4/3+3 advances game to Phase 4: all 2 and 1+1 trains scrapped immediately, train limits drop by 1 (Minor 1, Corporation 3), and corporations require 4 shares to float. Paired in stack with 3+3 (total pool: 3). Rusted upon first 4D train.
rules: Scores up to 4 cities, or up to 3 towns (assuming 1 city) along a continuous route.
Must include an owned station token.
Purchasing first 4/3+3 scraps all 2 and 1+1 trains.
Rusted and removed from the game without compensation upon purchase of the first 4D train.

18_scan_3p3.summary: Plus 3+3 train (max 3 cities and up to 5 towns)
18_scan_3p3.notes: Phase 4 plus locomotive. Costs K20 less than regular 4-train. Paired in stack with 4-train (total pool: 3). Rusted upon purchase of first 4D train.
rules: Scores up to 3 cities and up to 5 towns (assuming 1 city) along a continuous route.
Must include an owned station token.
Costs K280 (K20 discount relative to regular 4-train).
Rusted and removed from the game without compensation upon purchase of the first 4D train.

18_scan_5.notes: Permanent locomotive. Purchasing first 5/4+4 advances game to Phase 5: all 3 and 2+2 trains scrapped, brown tiles available, third off-map values used, train limits drop (Corporation 2, SJ 3), all Private and Minor companies close immediately, SJ is eligible to form, remaining 5/4+4 train moves to Pool, 5E trains become available, and new corporations require 5 shares to float with full 10-share funding. Paired in stack with 4+4 (total pool: 2).
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts.
Scores up to 5 cities, or up to 4 towns (assuming 1 city) along a continuous route.
Must include an owned station token.
Purchasing first 5/4+4 scraps all 3 and 2+2 trains and closes all Private and Minor companies.

18_scan_4p4.summary: Plus 4+4 permanent train (max 4 cities and up to 7 towns)
18_scan_4p4.notes: Permanent locomotive. Costs K20 less than regular 5-train. Paired in stack with 5-train (total pool: 2).
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts.
Scores up to 4 cities and up to 7 towns (assuming 1 city) along a continuous route.
Must include an owned station token.
Costs K480 (K20 discount relative to regular 5-train).

18_scan_5e.name: 5E
18_scan_5e.summary: Express 5E train (up to 5 cities, ignores all towns; permanent)
18_scan_5e.notes: Permanent express locomotive. Becomes available after first 5/4+4 train is purchased. Purchasing first 5E unlocks 4D trains (remaining 5E moves to Pool). Pool: 2 trains at K600. Train limit: Corporation 2, SJ 3.
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts.
Scores up to 5 cities along a continuous unbranched route.
Completely ignores all towns on route (treated as 0 value and do not count against city limit).
Cannot score Kiruna (town) or benefit from the Kiruna Mine bonus (+K50).
Eligible for Ferry bonus (+K20) across Turku-Stockholm Ferry if token owned.
Must include an owned station token.

18_scan_4d.name: 4D
18_scan_4d.summary: High-Speed Diesel 4D train (up to 4 cities, 2x revenue, ignores towns; permanent)
18_scan_4d.notes: Permanent high-speed locomotive. Becomes available after first 5E train is purchased. Purchasing first 4D scraps all remaining 4 and 3+3 trains immediately. Pool: 6 trains at K800. Train limit: Corporation 2, SJ 3.
rules: Permanent locomotive: Never rusts.
Purchasing first 4D immediately scraps all 4 and 3+3 trains.
Scores up to 4 cities along a continuous route, ignoring all towns (treated as 0 value and do not count toward distance).
DOUBLES the total sum of all city values on its route!
DOUBLES the Turku-Stockholm Ferry bonus to +K40 if company owns Ferry bonus token!
Cannot score Kiruna (town) or benefit from the Kiruna Mine bonus.
Must include an owned station token.
